def factor_smooth_directional_pressure(df):
    """Simplified directional pressure: intraday minus overnight return smoothed with a single EWMA span of 5. Removes adaptive volume-span switching to reduce noise."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(
        df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]
    )
    raw_pressure = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    span = 5
    smoothed = raw_pressure.ewm(span=span, min_periods=span).mean()
    df_copy["factor_smooth_directional_pressure"] = smoothed
    return df_copy["factor_smooth_directional_pressure"]
description: Simplification of the parent's adaptive smoothing by removing volume-adaptive span switching. The core signal (intraday minus overnight return) is smoothed with a fixed EWMA span of 5. This removes a source of instability from the binary switch based on volume ratio, targeting improved ICIR and RankICIR while preserving the strong IC and RankIC of the directional pressure signal.
